entry.title: MPC Skipback 0.6.2
entry.summary: Gen2 Live III fixes: the audio card is found from /proc/asound/cards when there is no platform-sound link (without it nothing saved), and Overdub's LED is controller 84 on the MPC family (the LED now flashes). Device-confirmed on a Gen2 Live III, MPC OS 3.10.

entry.title: MPC Skipback 0.6.0
entry.summary: **MPC Skipback 0.6.0**: first stable release. - Records the main output all the time; double-press **Rec Arm** (Force), or hold **Shift** and press **Overdub** (other MPC models, untested there), to save the last 30 s as a WAV. `button=learn` teaches it any button. - Finds the next ALSA hook with libc's own `dlsym`, so an addin that interposes `dlsym` cannot hide the other shims. - Tested on an Akai Force (MPC OS 3.9.1).
